profile.headline: Founding Front-End Engineering Lead at Keyora, Inc.
profile.summary:
Im a front-end engineering leader with a background in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), user experience, and accessibility. I enjoy building intuitive, scalable, and maintainable applications that make complex technology easier to use.

Currently, Im the Founding Front-End Engineering Lead at Keyora, where Im helping shape the front-end architecture, engineering practices, and user experience of AI-powered legal technology.

Previously, at Stanfords ROAR, I worked at the intersection of engineering, research, and product development, leading initiatives across adaptive assessments, application architecture, authentication, and user-facing platforms.

Im passionate about bridging technical complexity with thoughtful design, translating ambiguous ideas into meaningful products, and building engineering foundations that help both products and teams grow.

positions.title: Founding Front-End Engineering Lead
positions.description:
- Lead front-end engineering at Keyora, building intuitive, user-centered experiences for AI-powered legal technology.
- Drive front-end architecture, technical direction, and engineering best practices to establish a scalable and maintainable foundation.
- Collaborate across product, design, and engineering to shape the product experience and support future team growth.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Technical Leadership · Front-End Development · Software Architecture

positions.title: Software Engineer - Assessment & Frontend Engineering Lead
positions.description:
- Helped drive CATification across ROAR’s assessment suite, including jsCAT/Clowder enhancements, adaptive assessment standardization, and integrations across multiple assessments. 
- Led technical implementation for normed score updates across the assessment suite, including standardization and cross-team coordination. 
- Redesigned and implemented the login flow end-to-end after identifying user-facing errors, conducting user research, proposing improvements, and shipping a major dashboard UX enhancement.  
- Led development of the Assessment SDK and run event endpoints as part of a broader backend refactor, helping establish new architectural foundations for future assessment integrations.  
- Translate ambiguous research, product, and psychometric requirements into clear technical implementation plans for engineers and researchers. 
- Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and research partners to surface blockers early, align requirements, and improve platform reliability. 
- Mentor and support collaborators across assessment implementation, frontend quality, adaptive testing, and maintainable software practices.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Part of the Dev team at ROAR (Rapid Online Assessment of Reading), an open-access assessment platform grounded in ongoing research by the Stanford Reading & Dyslexia Research Program.

positions.title: Graduate Research And Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Led ML chatbot project, addressing dev and user challenges. Assisted real-time diversity dashboard. Aided sensemaking in computational notebooks and designing solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Figma (Software) · HTML · CSS · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
GIIT Group
Projects: “Fog Computing applied to monitor devices used in ambient assisted living environments, case study: a platform for the elderly”.
•	Elaboration of a set of games called “Album of Memories” for older adults to train attention and memory functions in hand with psychologist experts.
•	Use of Visual Studio Tool with the Ionic and AngularJS framework.
•	Deploy a Puzzle Game on the web to perform the initial experimental phase of the research.
•	Systematic Review: The systematic review and the matrix of previous findings were carried out for the completion of the papers “Improving the Cognitive Functions in Seniors Supported by Serious Games: A Systematic Literature Review” (in progress) and “Serious Games as an Instrument to Support Elderly People: A Systematic Literature Review” (in progress).
•	Elaboration of the social media web pages for the GIIT Research Group.

positions.description:

- Extract data from HEC-RAS to calculate Manning coefficient to represent the roughness applied to the flow by the river's channel.
